description: This Kotlin source file defines a test implementation of the RecentSearchRepository interface, providing in-memory storage and operations for recent search queries for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestRecentSearchRepository
classes.description: A test implementation of the RecentSearchRepository interface that stores recent searches in-memory for testing.

methods.name: getRecentSearchQueries
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting a list of recent search queries, sorted by queriedDate descending, limited by the provided limit.

methods.name: insertOrReplaceRecentSearch
methods.description: Inserts a new recent search query into the in-memory cache.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears all cached recent search queries.
